units.english: Generators (Candle Class)
units.italian: Generators (Candle Class)

units.english: This tiny generator produces a significant amount of energy using the heat produced by the radioactive decay of some particularly unstable nuclear isotopes.
units.italian: This tiny generator produces a significant amount of energy using the heat produced by the radioactive decay of some particularly unstable nuclear isotopes.

units.english: Generators (Furnace Class)
units.italian: Generators (Furnace Class)

units.english: Because Korath equipment is so power-hungry, they use radiothermal generators even in their fighters and interceptors, rather than relying on fuel cells or other comparable technology.
units.italian: Because Korath equipment is so power-hungry, they use radiothermal generators even in their fighters and interceptors, rather than relying on fuel cells or other comparable technology.

units.english: Generators (Inferno Class)
units.italian: Generators (Inferno Class)

units.english: With their typical disregard for the environmental impacts of their technology, the Korath put some rather alarming isotopes into this radiothermal generator. Its considerable energy output is offset by the heat it produces.
units.italian: With their typical disregard for the environmental impacts of their technology, the Korath put some rather alarming isotopes into this radiothermal generator. Its considerable energy output is offset by the heat it produces.

units.english: This compact Fusion Reactor is an ancient Korath design, and served as the mainstay of their war fleets until larger ships and more powerful weapons created a need for bigger and more powerful generators.
units.italian: This compact Fusion Reactor is an ancient Korath design, and served as the mainstay of their war fleets until larger ships and more powerful weapons created a need for bigger and more powerful generators.

units.english: This reactor core combines a pair of the ancient and robust Korath Plasma Cores into a single package.
units.italian: This reactor core combines a pair of the ancient and robust Korath Plasma Cores into a single package.

units.english: For the largest of their capital ships, the Korath designed a fusion reactor far more powerful than any comparable human technology.
units.italian: For the largest of their capital ships, the Korath designed a fusion reactor far more powerful than any comparable human technology.

units.english: The sheer inefficiency of most Korath equipment has forced them to become exceptionally good at one thing: dealing with large amounts of waste heat.
units.italian: The sheer inefficiency of most Korath equipment has forced them to become exceptionally good at one thing: dealing with large amounts of waste heat.

units.english: Without these powerful cooling systems, most Korath warships would overheat within seconds as soon as they began to fire their weapons.
units.italian: Without these powerful cooling systems, most Korath warships would overheat within seconds as soon as they began to fire their weapons.

units.english: This active cooling system uses a liquid sodium cooling loop to extract heat from the ship's hottest systems. A secondary system draws a moderate amount of power to continuously run the pump and maintain a minimum temperature in order to keep the sodium from freezing when the system is inactive.
units.italian: This active cooling system uses a liquid sodium cooling loop to extract heat from the ship's hottest systems. A secondary system draws a moderate amount of power to continuously run the pump and maintain a minimum temperature in order to keep the sodium from freezing when the system is inactive.

units.english: Systems Cores (Tiny)
units.italian: Systems Cores (Tiny)

units.english: Most Korath fighter pilots dispense with Systems Cores, preferring to run larger than necessary generators and return to their mothership if they take damage. Usually, only civilian small craft operators are willing to sacrifice enough firepower to mount this shield generator, capacitor, swarm of repair microbots, and computer to control them.
units.italian: Most Korath fighter pilots dispense with Systems Cores, preferring to run larger than necessary generators and return to their mothership if they take damage. Usually, only civilian small craft operators are willing to sacrifice enough firepower to mount this shield generator, capacitor, swarm of repair microbots, and computer to control them.

units.english: Systems Cores (Small)
units.italian: Systems Cores (Small)

units.english: The heart of any Korath ship is the Systems Core, which houses the ship's central computer, shield generators, reserve power, and a small reservoir which stores, produces and recycles a small microbot swarm that can make minor repairs to the ship while in flight.
units.italian: The heart of any Korath ship is the Systems Core, which houses the ship's central computer, shield generators, reserve power, and a small reservoir which stores, produces and recycles a small microbot swarm that can make minor repairs to the ship while in flight.

units.english: Systems Cores (Medium)
units.italian: Systems Cores (Medium)

units.english: The Systems Core houses a powerful computer, shield generators, reserve power, and a control center for repair microbots that can move across a ship's exterior and slowly repair damage to the hull. The microbot reservoir is capable of supporting a significant swarm.
units.italian: The Systems Core houses a powerful computer, shield generators, reserve power, and a control center for repair microbots that can move across a ship's exterior and slowly repair damage to the hull. The microbot reservoir is capable of supporting a significant swarm.

units.english: Systems Cores (Large)
units.italian: Systems Cores (Large)

units.english: This massive bank of computers, shield generators, capacitors and repair microbot reservoirs holds everything needed to keep the very largest of Korath ships in working condition.
units.italian: This massive bank of computers, shield generators, capacitors and repair microbot reservoirs holds everything needed to keep the very largest of Korath ships in working condition.
